'''Officer Carver''' was scheduled to be a character in the [[Grand Theft Auto]] series who was dropped during the development of [[Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas]]. Carver would be a member of the [[Los Santos Police Department]] who would try to close the net around fellow officers [[Frank Tenpenny]], [[Eddie Pulaski|Edward "Eddie" Pulaski]] and [[Jimmy Hernandez]]. Carver would attempt to have Tenpenny's ally [[Poncho]] arrested in the hope that he will talk. Tenpenny would subsequently order protagonist [[Carl Johnson|Carl "CJ" Johnson]] to kill Carver in the beta version of the mission [[Doberman]].
